10 Timeless Step-by-Step Vintage Hairstyle Tutorials

THIS POST MAY CONTAIN AFFILIATE LINKS.
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 4:53
Instaread

Vintage hairstyles encompass a variety of looks, from pin curls to Hollywood waves to victory roll hairstyles. There are many classic, timeless styles that are still on trend today. While some are better suited for special occasions like weddings or themed events, others can be dressed down for casual day-to-day activities. If you love the retro aesthetic, we’ve rounded up 10 timeless step-by-step vintage hairstyle tutorials for every hair length.

3 Vintage Hairstyle Tutorials for Short Hair

1. Step by Step Pin-Curl and Brush-Out Hair Tutorial for Vintage Hair | Dollhouse ‘Do 

If you want to channel a 1940s pin-up babe, this tutorial is for you! She takes you through her step-by-step technique for creating pin-curls and shares the products she uses including a heat protectant, the NuMe Curling Wand and a hair shine spray. It’s a gorgeous retro look that will help you achieve your vintage glam dreams.

2. Vintage Hairstyle for Short Hair | @LillianMasie 

This hairstyle is so perfectly vintage and works flawlessly on hair that sits just above the shoulders. She starts off with freshly washed and dried hair and shows you the curling iron technique she uses to achieve the vintage waves. Along with a curling iron, you’ll need hairspray to set the curls and a brush to brush the curls out into waves.

3. Vintage Glam Wet Look Tutorial for Short Hair | Lillian Masie 

We absolutely love this vintage wet hair look. It’s incredibly chic and glam and is sure to pull you loads of compliments. You can dress it down with a tank top and jeans or dress it up for a special occasion. To get this fab look, you’ll need the Eco Style Hair Gel, hairspray and a comb.

3 Vintage Hairstyle Tutorials for Medium-Length Hair

1. 1940s Victory Roll Hair Tutorial | @Gabis_vintage 

This 1940s victory roll hairstyle is reminiscent of the 1940s. If you’re a fan of the movie The Notebook and want to channel Allie’s look, this is the perfect tutorial for you. To get the look, you’ll need products like a curling iron, bobby pins and hairspray as well as a paddle brush to brush out the curls.

2. Old Hollywood Hair Tutorial | @elenarachitskaya 

While Old Hollywood waves are often seen on long hair, this tutorial proves they look just as glam on shoulder-length strands. It’s a seriously stunning look that’s perfect to dress up for a vintage wedding or a themed party. She uses products like a curling iron, hair styling clips and hairspray to get the glam hairstyle.

3. 1940s Half-Up Hairstyle | @geenahunt 

This half-up half-down 1940s vintage hairstyle is incredibly darling. She starts off with wet hair and uses satin sponge hair rollers to achieve ringlet curls. She then uses a curl cream and comb to finish off the style. This look takes some time to do but is absolutely stunning for a special occasion.

4 Vintage Hairstyle Tutorials for Long Hair

1. 1960s Half Up Hairstyle | @geenahunt 

This is another half-up hairstyle by Geena Hunt, this time inspired by the 1960s. She uses a hot air styler brush along with texture spray and a comb to tease her hair for volume. The end look is so pretty and has the perfect amount of fluff and volume for a vintage ’60s look.

2. Iconic 1960s Hairstyles | ‘60s Hair Tutorial | Jackie Wyers 

In this tutorial, she shows you how to get 2 iconic 1960s hairstyles, including a half-up voluminous hairstyle and a classy twisted updo. For the first look, she shares her technique for getting flat iron curls and finishes off the hairstyle with a dainty bow. For the elegant ‘60s updo, you’ll need a flat iron again, plus pearl hair pins to make the look even more elegant.

3. Hollywood Wave Tutorial | @fayequeenan 

This is how you do Hollywood waves on long hair. She shows you the exact process she uses to get the look, including curling her hair with a curling iron, setting her bangs with styling clips and using hairspray to help with hold. It’s a timeless, glamorous hairstyle that’s perfect for a wedding or the holiday season.

These vintage hairstyles are all just as gorgeous today. Use these tutorials and products to get these looks for short, medium and long hair.
